privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Compass
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Assess your knowledge in privacy and security
privacyPolicy.notice: This privacy policy is currently being drafted and validated. The final document will establish the guidelines for processing, retention, and security of personal data in full compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018).

controller.title: Controller and Platform Purpose
controller.p1: Privacy Compass is a corporate diagnostic and training platform for privacy and information security, designed to map employee competencies and support institutional capability development.
controller.p2: Personal data processing within the platform follows data protection principles—specifically purpose limitation, adequacy, necessity, transparency, and security—in compliance with applicable privacy laws, including Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13.709/2018).

dataCollected.title: Personal Data Collected
dataCollected.p1: To enable authenticated access, journey personalization, and organizational indicators, we process only strictly necessary data:
dataCollected.b1: Registration and workplace data: full name, institutional email address, employee code, department/sector, and organization.
dataCollected.b2: Assessment and journey data: selected journey profile, competency questionnaire responses, calculated scores, and completion timestamps.
dataCollected.b3: Essential technical session data: strictly necessary cookies for secure authentication (HttpOnly), CSRF protection, and language or accessibility preferences.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.p1: Collected data is used exclusively for legitimate purposes tied to operating the training and assessment platform:
dataUsage.b1: Authenticate your identity, maintain session integrity, and enforce permission-based access control.
dataUsage.b2: Deliver journeys tailored to your profile, compute domain and area scores, and generate downloadable PDF reports.
dataUsage.b3: Provide consolidated metrics to duly authorized managers and administrators to guide training initiatives.
dataUsage.b4: Comply with legal or regulatory obligations and retain audit records to prevent security incidents.

sharingAndRetention.title: Sharing and Retention
sharingAndRetention.p1: Your personal data is never sold, rented, or shared with third parties for advertising or purposes unrelated to the platform's mission.
sharingAndRetention.p2: Internal access is restricted to administrative roles with explicit permissions (such as managers and administrators), and records are retained only for the duration required by institutional ties or legal obligations.

security.title: Information Security
security.p1: We implement technical and organizational safeguards aligned with security best practices to protect personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure:
security.b1: Authenticated sessions protected via HttpOnly cookies and CSRF token validation for state-changing requests.
security.b2: Secure credential storage using cryptographic hashing and encrypted transport (HTTPS).
security.b3: Granular role-based access control (RBAC) and automatic session expiration with prior inactivity warning.
security.b4: Account status management and profile update auditing for accountability.

userRights.title: Your Privacy Rights
userRights.p1: Under Art. 18 of the LGPD and applicable data protection regulations, you may exercise the following rights at any time:
userRights.b1: Confirm the existence of processing and access personal data associated with your account.
userRights.b2: Correct or update incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated information directly on your Profile page or through administration.
userRights.b3: Request clear information regarding data sharing, retention periods, and processing criteria.
userRights.b4: Request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary or non-compliant data, as well as revocation of consent where applicable.

updatesAndContact.title: Policy Updates and Contact
updatesAndContact.p1: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect platform improvements or regulatory updates, with the latest revision date displayed at the top of this page.
updatesAndContact.p2: For questions, requests, or to exercise your data subject rights, please contact your organization's Data Protection Officer (DPO) or the designated platform administration team.
